meta_description: Acorn Gardening Services in Newcastle. Professional garden maintenance, landscaping and design. Local, reliable, and fully insured. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Newcastle Gardener — Fully Insured & Reliable
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden design—we transform your outdoor space into somewhere you'll actually want to spend time.
services_heading: Complete Garden Services Across Newcastle & Gateshead
services_subhead: Whether you need a tidy-up, a complete redesign, or regular maintenance, we handle it all—on time, on budget.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly upkeep—hedge trimming, grass cutting, weeding and mulching. Keeps your garden looking sharp without the hard work.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: We'll design a garden that suits your space and lifestyle, then build it properly. Patios, raised beds, planting schemes—the lot.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim a neglected space. We clear, strip back and dispose of waste responsibly, leaving you with a blank canvas to work with.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning keeps trees healthy and safe. We work within proper forestry standards and haul away all arisings.

services.title: Lawn Care & Turfing
services.desc: Diseased or patchy lawn? We'll re-seed or lay new turf, then advise on feeding and maintenance to keep it green year-round.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: New patio, pathway or decking? We lay it level, seal it properly, and build features that last—not bodges that crack in one winter.

about_pullquote: I started Acorn because I couldn't stand seeing beautiful gardens turn into overgrown messes.
about_para_1: Acorn Gardening has been serving Newcastle and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've never lost sight of doing things properly—no shortcuts, no surprises, and a guarantee you'll be happy with the work.
about_para_2: Our customers come back year after year because we treat their garden like it matters. We listen, we're honest about what's realistic, and we turn up when we say we will. We're fully insured and we dispose of all waste responsibly. Reputation is everything in this game, and ours is built on showing up, doing the job well, and caring about the detail.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Gardeners Say About Acorn

reviews.text: Brilliant lads. My back garden was a total jungle—trees everywhere, weeds you wouldn't believe. They came in, cleared the lot, made it safe, and now it actually looks like a garden. Not the cheapest, but you get what you pay for. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: We've had Acorn round every other week for two years now. The lawn's never looked better, the hedges are tidy, and they're just reliable blokes who get on with it. No drama, fair price. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Sarah W.

reviews.text: Had a new patio laid by Acorn in the spring. Excellent work, very professional, and they cleaned up properly after themselves. Garden's now the envy of the street. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: David M.
